title: Training Support Options (Pronto Forms)
description: This proposal outlines tailored training options to support in enhancing their team's proficiency with Pronto Forms. The primary goal is to provide practical, face-to-face sessions that revisit key functionalities and address specific operational needs.

sections.title: Cover Letter
sections.description:
As requested, I have outlined the options for Pronto Forms training.


Enclosed, you will find details for both half-day and full-day refresher sessions, along with associated costs for each.


Based on our recent conversation, the half-day training session should be enough for us to go over all aspects of what you will need to proceed with future in-house development, which will be more focused around the data-sources, and data-output aspects of Pronto Forms.


Additionally - As we currently have no management, maintenance or hosting agreements in-place; meaning a travel fee applies for travel over 100 km; should you wish I deliver this training face-to-face at your preferred location (Sales Yard, 196 Nursery Road, Macksville).


Please let me know if you have any questions or require further adjustments to meet your needs.


I look forward to the opportunity to support your team again, thank you for your time and consideration.

items.title: COMMENT
items.description:
Pronto Forms Training Refresher

- As discussed, here is my current pricing to provide 'face-to-face training' support for Pronto Forms. I have included both options for reference, however, you have asked for a half-day session, as we will not need to dive into a full form building exercise again and just touch on specific features/design aspects specific to Midcoast Trucks.


Half Day Training (Requested)

items.title: Half-Day Training - Refresher (Unmanaged)
items.description:
This refresher training covers:

- This refresher training provides a comprehensive review of key software functionalities, focusing on enhancing familiarity with core features and addressing any specific use cases relevant to your proposed operations. Delivered face-to-face, the session ensures clear guidance and practical support to help your team effectively use the system.

items.title: Full-Day Training - Refresher (Unmanaged)
items.description:
This covers the following:

- This full-day training provides an in-depth review of key software functionalities, incorporating comprehensive guidance on advanced features and workflows. It covers practical use cases, recent updates, and tailored solutions to align with your operational needs. Delivered face-to-face, the session includes hands-on exercises and detailed discussions to ensure your team gains the knowledge and skills required for proficient and confident use of the system.
